blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Tax compliance is simple work. It means following the rules. You file the right forms. You pay the right amounts. You do it on the right dates, with the right documents.

When a company is compliant, the tax office has no questions. When it is not, the tax office has many. Compliance is not about being clever. It is about being on time, accurate, and ready to explain any unusual entry.

Most mistakes are not dramatic. They are small errors that grew because nobody saw them in time. A company with good habits quietly avoids most problems. In tax, boring is a compliment.

items.q: What does tax compliance mean?
items.why: "It means following the rules." — conformidade é seguir as regras.

items.q: When a company is compliant, the tax office…
items.why: "When a company is compliant, the tax office has no questions."

items.q: According to the text, most tax mistakes are…
options: small errors nobody saw in time
items.why: "They are small errors that grew because nobody saw them in time."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: Small mistakes can grow into big problems.
Being on time matters in tax.
You should be clever and creative to be good at tax.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "Compliance is not about being clever" — ser esperto/criativo não é o ponto.

items.q: "In tax, boring is a compliment" suggests that…
options: a quiet, error-free routine is a good thing
items.why: Inferência: "boring" aqui é elogio — rotina calma e sem erros é o objetivo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Charlotte falando com o novo assistente. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team. Let me show you a simple routine. It is not exciting, but it works.

Every Monday, we check the calendar. We write down every form and every payment due this week. If something is due on Friday, we do not wait until Friday. We start on Monday.

Every day, we check one thing: are the numbers accurate? If an entry looks unusual, we do not ignore it. We ask a question now. Small mistakes are easy to fix today. Next month, they are not.

Last year, the old team was always busy fixing problems. They fixed the same errors again and again. Why? Because nobody looked at them early. That is the difference. We do the boring check on time, and we stay calm.

So, your first job is simple. Learn the calendar. Learn the dates. If you are ever not sure, ask me. It is much better to ask a small question than to fix a big mistake later.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does the team do every Monday?
options: They check the calendar and write down what is due
items.why: "Every Monday, we check the calendar. We write down every form and every payment due this week."

items.q: If a form is due on Friday, what does the team do?
options: They ask the tax office for more time
items.why: "If something is due on Friday, we do not wait until Friday. We start on Monday."

items.q: What does Charlotte do when an entry looks unusual?
items.why: "If an entry looks unusual, we do not ignore it. We ask a question now."

items.q: Why was the old team always busy?
options: They fixed the same errors again because nobody looked early
They had no calendar at all
items.why: Inferência: "They fixed the same errors again and again… nobody looked at them early."

items.q: What is Charlotte's main message to the new assistant?
options: Work fast and skip the boring checks
A calm, on-time routine prevents big problems
Tax work is exciting and dramatic
items.why: Inferência: ela valoriza a rotina calma e no prazo, e prefere perguntar cedo a consertar tarde.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We must file the form before Friday." To file a form means to…
options: send it to the tax office
items.why: To file = declarar/entregar o documento à autoridade.

items.q: "The numbers must be accurate." Accurate means…
items.why: Accurate = preciso, correto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please check the ___ we paid. I think it is too high."
items.why: Amount = valor/quantia — o que foi pago.

items.q: "There is one unusual entry in the report." An unusual entry is…
options: a line that looks different or strange
items.why: Unusual entry = lançamento incomum, que chama atenção.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "When the company is ___, the tax office has no questions."
items.why: Compliant = conforme, em dia com as regras.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs que aparecem no trabalho de conformidade. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the report before we file it." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new routine next week." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = colocar em prática, implementar.

items.q: "Let's keep on top of the dates this month." This means to…
items.why: Keep on top of = manter sob controle, acompanhar de perto.

items.q: "The old team never followed through on their checks." They…
options: did not carry the checks to the end
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "If you are not sure, please flag it up early." To flag something up means to…
options: point it out so people notice
items.why: Flag up = sinalizar, chamar atenção para algo cedo.
